run_brodatz_handler: run the brodatz_handler function to import Brodatz texture dataset and return metadata and split generators
create_class_names: create sorted class names from a list of filenames using the _get_class_names helper function
generate_texture_crops: generate 9 non-overlapping cropped regions from each Brodatz texture image split into train dev dev-test and test sets
select_subset_split: select a subset of image samples filtered by train dev or test split labels using select_subset
download_brodatz_dataset: download the 112 Brodatz texture images via the brodatz_dataset DownloadableDataset object with checksums and handler
